payload.reason: The evidence provides a comparison of the GM_KL approach with other word sense disambiguation (WSD) methods using word embeddings, specifically highlighting its performance advantages.

claims.text: The GM_KL approach outperforms previous models like w2g and w2gm on benchmark word similarity and entailment datasets.
GM_KL effectively captures polysemy and uncertainty in word meanings better than traditional models that do not account for multiple meanings.
The KL divergence based energy function used in GM_KL provides a better distance metric for capturing entailment and distribution similarity among words.
